summary: Rewrote monthly_statement to follow the current Meridale pages. It sends only merchant_id, canonical tz, half-open from/to and a BCP 47 locale, rounds half-even from Decimal at the currency's digits, and writes amounts and totals in locale style. Zones the docs table doesn't list are passed through unchanged, and a non-whole-hour fixed offset raises ValueError because Meridale has no zone for it. Only the existing unit test was run; it passes.
